contexts.text: In the third state, he, from the internal man, speaks piously and devoutly.
Of those who have led a pious life, the Lord takes much care...
He who believes that piety of life is not possible without merit being placed in works... extinguishes with himself all piety of life, and gives himself up to cupidities...
In misfortunes... the man begins to think piously... and also to exercise the works of piety...
As in what is good and pious the Lord is present...
They may indeed read the Word... from piety...

With the man of the Church there must be the life of piety and the life of charity. They must be conjoined. The life of piety without the life of charity is conducive to nothing; but the former with the latter to all things. HH 360:2. HH 535:3.

The life of piety is to think piously and to speak piously, to pray much, to behave humbly then, to frequent places of worship, and then to hearken devoutly to the preachings, and to approach the Sacrament of the Supper frequently every year, and so with all the other things of worship according to the ordinances of the Church. NJHD 124.

The life of piety without the life of charity is to want to consult for one's self alone... But the life of piety with the life of charity is to want to consult for one's self for the sake of the neighbour...
Hence the life of piety does not remain with man to eternity, except in so far as it accords with the life of charity.
Hence those who think about eternal salvation place it in a life of piety...
What is holy and pious, but is not from love, is indeed heard, but is not gratefully received. Explained.
A life of piety abstracted from a life of charity is difficult, and leads away from Heaven...
Concerning piety. Chapter.
Piety without charity... does not make spiritual life; but piety from charity.
Divine worship consists... secondarily in (a life of piety). AE 325:6.
He who leads a life of piety (only), does not worship God. Explained.
External holiness is like such piety...
To be continually in pious meditation... and reading pious books... is not to renounce the world. (Explained.)
(Thus) a life of piety avails and is accepted by the Lord, in proportion as a life of charity is conjoined with it...
He reads... books of piety, etc., and does not know whether he does these things from himself, or from God. Explained.
That if man thinks and speaks pious things, and does not shun evils as sins, the pious things are not pious. Explained.
The exercises of his piety are either merely a matter of habit, or are meritorious, or hypocritical. Enumerated.
The Word teaches that in proportion as man has not been purified from evils... his pious things are not pious. Illustrated.
The fourth kind of profanation is [committed] by those who speak pious and holy things... and yet at heart do not believe and love them. Explained. AE 1061:2. AE 1062:3.
Love them on account of their actual piety, or piety of life... CL 2.
If man (then) worships God with actual piety, he becomes an image of God...
But if he does not worship Him with actual piety, he puts off the image of God...
Even those who have been devoted to piety are perverted by them.
He said, Piety inspired by piteousness is charity, Explained... My boat is piety; and besides, piety is useful for all things.
All pious men... will assent to this... but few will act accordingly.
You have followed the pursuits of piety; but have you ever examined your internal man...
(The Spirits of the gall-bladder) are such as in life utterly despise what is pious...
Sirens who by an appearance of piety enter into the minds of others...
From misfortunes they have exhibited themselves as pious... But they are distinguished by the Angels in every state of piety.
(Those who affect the tongue with pain) are such as... have simulated piety in every manner...
As he has been among the pietists...
Such are those in a life of piety, and not in one of charity.
Some of these have been revengeful... but still have exercised piety.
See Last Judgment. SE 5342. SE 5377. SE 5378. SE 5392. SE 5768.
He said he could not go bowed, like those in such piety. He was told that such piety does not make Heaven...
Those who adore piously in places of worship; and, then, think solely about God, and nothing as to the life, correspond to adultery with a sister.
Very many who had led a life of piety... but, as they had not loved any use, they were cast out.
Under Devotion, see this reference.
He who adopts the principle that piety and the goods of charity effect nothing...
They are modest and pious, but study self essentially...
Those who place all Divine worship in oral piety, and not in actual piety, greatly err. Explained. Actual piety is to act from what is sincere and right, and just and fair, in every work...
(This) is external piety, (Described.) and is not piety, but hypocrisy, habit, or what is persuasive...
Heaven is insinuated into the actual piety of man, and not into oral or external piety separated therefrom...
When it was perceived... that their external piety did not proceed from actual piety... they were cast down.
Their pious things are not pious things...
5. (These) are the uses of external charity, which charity is called piety.
Those who seduce by a show of piety... DeConj 98.
A pious and good man receives both (Heaven and the world)...
